hero_description: We use AI to compress the slow parts of insurance shopping — intake, carrier matching, paperwork — down to minutes. Every quote is still reviewed, and every policy is still bound, by a licensed Florida producer who knows your risk. Commercial, business auto, and personal lines, from an agency built for how fast your business actually moves.
meta_description: Protection Partners is a Florida independent insurance agency built around commercial and business auto coverage, backed by licensed producers who quote fast and bind every policy themselves.

why_points: No 40-field PDF before you get a call back.
No CSR reading your risk off a script.
A producer who already has your numbers when they call.

proof_points.title: Speed-to-quote
proof_points.body: Our intake is a five-minute form, not a phone tag exercise. AI structures your submission the moment you hit send so a producer opens your file already knowing your risk.

proof_points.title: Licensed FL producers bind every policy
proof_points.body: Nothing this site collects becomes a bound policy on its own. A Florida-licensed producer reviews every submission, quotes it against real carriers, and is the one who binds it.

proof_points.title: Commercial + business auto specialty
proof_points.body: We built this agency around the coverage general agencies treat as an afterthought — commercial auto, fleet, and business property for operators who can't afford a lapse.

lines_of_business.meta_description: Commercial and business auto coverage from a Florida agency built around fleets, contractors, and operators who can't afford a lapse.
lines_of_business.h1: Commercial & business auto, quoted by people who understand fleets.
lines_of_business.intro: Most agencies treat commercial auto as a line item. We built this agency around it — because a lapsed policy or a bad classification can shut a fleet down for weeks. Tell us your vehicles, your operation, and your drivers, and a licensed producer will get you real numbers.

coverages.title: Commercial auto & fleet
coverages.body: Single vehicle to multi-truck fleets — liability, physical damage, and hired/non-owned auto for operations that can't afford a lapse.

coverages.title: General liability
coverages.body: Premises, operations, and products liability sized to how your business actually operates, not a generic template limit.

coverages.title: Business owners policy (BOP)
coverages.body: Property and liability bundled for eligible small-to-midsize operations — one policy instead of three.

coverages.title: Workers' compensation
coverages.body: Florida-compliant coverage for crews, contractors, and mixed-classification workforces.

coverages.title: Commercial property
coverages.body: Buildings, equipment, and inventory — including builder's risk for active renovation or construction projects.

coverages.title: Umbrella / excess liability
coverages.body: Extra limits layered over your primary policies once your operation, fleet, or portfolio outgrows base coverage.

lines_of_business.final_cta_body: Contractors, delivery and logistics operators, service fleets, artisan trades, and any Florida business where a vehicle is a working asset — not a commuter car. If your risk needs a real classification conversation instead of a dropdown menu, this is the line we exist for.

lines_of_business.meta_description: Home, auto, umbrella, and flood coverage for Florida households, quoted fast by licensed producers who bind every policy themselves.
lines_of_business.h1: Home, auto, and umbrella coverage that fits Florida, not a national template.
lines_of_business.intro: Florida homeowners deal with risk most states don't — wind, flood, and a hard insurance market. We quote against carriers who actually write Florida risk, and a licensed producer walks you through it before you sign anything.

coverages.title: Homeowners
coverages.body: Single-family, condo, and rental dwelling coverage sized to Florida wind and flood exposure — not a copy-paste national template.

coverages.title: Personal auto
coverages.body: Liability, collision, and comprehensive for your household vehicles, with real bundling discounts when paired with home.

coverages.title: Renters
coverages.body: Fast, affordable coverage for tenants — often quoted same-day.

coverages.title: Personal umbrella
coverages.body: Extra liability limits above your home and auto policies for households with real assets to protect.

coverages.title: Flood
coverages.body: Where indicated by your location, flood is quoted alongside your homeowners policy — not left for you to discover later.

coverages.title: Boat & recreational
coverages.body: Coverage for the boat, the trailer, and the weekend — for Florida households that actually use the water.

lines_of_business.final_cta_heading: Five minutes, one form, a real call back
lines_of_business.final_cta_body: No mega-menu of product pages to dig through. Tell us about your household once and a licensed Florida producer takes it from there.

team.name: Mariam Shapira
team.bio: Mariam founded Protection Partners to fix the two things that frustrate Florida business owners most about buying insurance: slow intake and CSRs who don't understand the risk. She personally reviews commercial and business auto submissions before they're quoted.
